title: Export a changed task component when the data branch already holds a memory component
outcome: Export a changed task component when the data branch already holds a memory component
acceptance: When the committed data HEAD holds a memory component and local tasks differ from it, one documented export command (with --include-memories) rewrites the task component and updates the memory component in the data worktree, under the publication lock, without refusing; uncommitted edits in the worktree still refuse with a named reason
A behavioural test covers: host A publishes memories; A changes a task; the documented refresh export succeeds and A's later import on host B applies both the task change and the memories
Refusals on this path name the deciding check and the remedy (refusals explain themselves)
